items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: We used to do her dates

ctx.x: Are there things that stick out in your memory as great sessions, or terrible? That’s always a hard question, there’s so many of them.
Yeah, it is. There’s — I won’t say great or not-so-great — but interesting in some respects. Do you know the name Connie Francis?
